parts:
Hey D-Ruggers,

Today at D-RUG Bonnie Dixon will give a presentation on handling time and date data in R. She will discuss few data classes that are available for times and dates, and will demonstrate some examples of manipulations and calculations.

We'll meet as usual in Wickson 2120J, 3-5PM.  After Bonnie's talk we will have our usual co-work/Q&A time, and there will be cookies.

Best,

Noam
